stock.description: Yum China Holdings, Inc. stands as a prominent restaurant corporation in China, dedicated to the ownership, management, and franchising of a broad array of dining establishments throughout the country. Its operations are primarily structured around two significant divisions: KFC and Pizza Hut. The company's extensive brand portfolio includes well-known names like KFC, Pizza Hut, Little Sheep, Huang Ji Huang, Lavazza, COFFii & JOY, Taco Bell, and East Dawning, collectively catering to diverse culinary tastes with offerings such as fried chicken, pizza, hot pot, simmer pots, Italian and specialty coffees, Mexican-inspired dishes, and authentic Chinese cuisine. In addition to its restaurant ventures, Yum China oversees V-Gold Mall, a dedicated mobile e-commerce platform. This online retail channel provides a variety of goods, from electronics, home goods, and kitchen accessories to general merchandise, alongside convenient ready-to-eat meals like fried rice, steak, and pasta, and coffee capsules. By March 31, 2022, the enterprise had cultivated a vast presence, operating 12,117 restaurants across approximately 1,700 cities. Yum China Holdings, Inc. was established in 2016 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Shanghai, China.
